findings.sampson_error_conflation: Phase 7C.2R4P4-R3 incorrectly labeled epipolar Sampson distance quantities (40.3467, 4.3148, 1.3360) as PIXEL_REPROJECTION_RMS. In addition, Candidate A's Sampson error (40.3467) was erroneously paired with the true-pixel improvement percentage (21.89%). These metrics belong to distinct mathematical namespaces and are now formally decoupled.

SAMPSON_ERROR.domain: Pairwise epipolar algebraic distance x_2^T F x_1 / (J_F)

TRUE_PIXEL_REPROJECTION.domain: Depth-backed 3D backprojection and camera-to-camera forward/reverse pixel reprojection
